subject: Saving plots in a pdf file

messages.author: de2c0368d9349f5a
messages.subject: Saving plots in a pdf file
parts:
Hi all,

I have a total of 44 items, analyzed using a 3PL model. I am using the following command to save  the empirical.plot, for each items:

pdf(paste(filesave,"ajusteitem.pdf",sep=""))
for(i in seq(1,nI)){
itemfit(resultM3P, empirical.plot=c(i), Theta=matrix(rthetaM3))  
}
dev.off()

Indeed, the pdf file is saved, but I can not see any figure. I would like to have all 44 plots, saved in a single pdf files, each one in a differnet page.

Thanks in advance for any help.

Caio

messages.author: dff35b5719cbb7c3
messages.subject: Re: Saving plots in a pdf file
parts:
to be more specific:


pdf(paste(filesave,"ajusteitem.pdf",sep=""), onefile = TRUE)
for(i in seq(1,nI)){
print(itemfit(resultM3P, empirical.plot=c(i), Theta=matrix(rthetaM3)))
cat("\n") #Sometimes it helps formatting to add a newline after each image
}
dev.off()

Dear Scott and Dan,

Thank you very much for your answers. I will try the Scott's suggestion. By the way, it worked well using:

pdf(paste(filesave,"ajusteitem.pdf",sep=""))
for(i in 1 : nI){
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
#plot.new()  
plot(itemfit(resultM3P1, empirical.plot=i, Theta=matrix(rthetaM31)))
}
dev.off()

Best and thanks,

Caio
